main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads a grid size and queue of node ids, builds a grid adjacency graph with boundary markers, processes the queue to propagate a possible-state through graph edges and cross-neighbor activation, and prints the resulting count." main]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> args </REF>: String[] "Command-line arguments; not used by the method."
        <REF> stdin </REF>: FastScanner "Provides n followed by n*n integer node ids to enqueue."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> stdout </REF>: int "The computed count is printed without a trailing newline."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize a FastScanner, read integer n from standard input, and set up local state: flag=true, x=1, count=0, int[][] m as an n by n zero-filled matrix, graph as an empty ArrayList of ArrayLists, boolean arrays exist and possible of length n*n, fill exist with true and possible with false, set as an empty HashSet, and queue as an empty ArrayDeque. RESULT initial_state]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 to n-1 inclusive and for j from 0 to n-1 inclusive, create an unused ArrayList near, append a new empty adjacency list to graph, and for the 1-based node id x: if i==0 or i==n-1 or j==0 or j==n-1 add x to set; using short-circuit conditions, if x-1 > i*n add x-1 to graph.get(x-1), if x+1 <= n*(i+1) add x+1, if x-n > 0 add x-n, and if x+n <= n*n add x+n; then read integer p from the FastScanner, enqueue p, assign m[i][j]=x, and increment x by 1. RESULT graph_queue_and_grid_built]
            [COMMAND While queue.size() > 0, poll a 1-based node id a from queue, set exist[a-1]=false, and if set contains a set possible[a-1]=true. RESULT processing_state]
            [COMMAND Within the queue-processing loop, if possible[a-1] is true, for each graph neighbor w in graph.get(a-1) set possible[w-1]=true; this branch does not modify count. RESULT processing_state]
            [COMMAND Within the queue-processing loop, if possible[a-1] is false, scan each graph neighbor w in graph.get(a-1); if possible[w-1]==true and exist[w-1]==false (short-circuit AND), set possible[a-2], possible[a-1-n], possible[a], possible[a-1+n], and possible[a-1] to true, decrement count by 1, and break out of the neighbor scan. RESULT processing_state]
            [COMMAND Within the queue-processing loop, in the branch where possible[a-1] is false, after the neighbor scan for a non-possible node (whether or not it broke early), increment count by 1; then evaluate the guard (a-2>=0) OR (a-1-n>=0) OR (a<=n*n) OR (a-1+n<=n*n) with short-circuit OR; if the guard is true, evaluate (exist[a-2]==false && possible[a-2]==true) OR (exist[a-1-n]==false && possible[a-1-n]==true) OR (exist[a]==false && possible[a]==true) OR (exist[a-1+n]==false && possible[a-1+n]==true) with short-circuit OR, and if this inner condition is true set possible[a-2], possible[a-1-n], possible[a], possible[a-1+n], and possible[a-1] to true without changing count. RESULT processing_state]
            [COMMAND Print the value of count to standard output using System.out.print. RESULT count]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
